audit.why: FAVOURED / 4-rating fits: Karma out-ranges Soraka's Starcall and Soraka has no lane engage, matching the all-Karma level chart.
Spikes correctly track level-2, level-6 Mantra range advantage, and item-based mana sustain edge; chart holding Karma all 7 rows matches the FAVOURED rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and spikes[0].text invent mechanics not in the kit: 'every Soraka heal-cast slows her into your trade' and 'she roots herself' when casting Starcall (Q). The kit only says Starcall slows enemies it hits and heals Soraka if it hits an enemy champion — it does not slow or root Soraka herself. missingInteractions flags Equinox's silence removing your escape/answer, unmentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'A star falls... dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.' No self-slow or self-root exists for Soraka on this ability.
audit.corrected: Rewrite whys[0] and spikes[0].text to state the real interaction: Starcall only heals Soraka if it lands on an enemy champion, so a whiff costs her mana for nothing. Fold the silence-denies-answer interaction into breakdown.trading.
